tools.name: list_directories
tools.description: List the public, source-backed directories of U.S. consumer brands using flexible packaging (pet food, coffee, compostable/recyclable). Returns each directory id, entry count, last update, web page URL, and CSV download URL.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Search brands in the public flexible packaging directories by keyword (brand name, category, packaging format such as "valve bag", "stand-up pouch", "compostable", or evidence text). Every keyword must match. Each result includes the observed packaging format, official evidence, official source URL,

tools.name: get_evidence_policy
tools.description: Explain how to interpret directory data: the Observed / Derived / Inferred / Unknown evidence labels and what public packaging evidence cannot prove. Call this before drawing conclusions about a brand’s suppliers, materials, or buying intent.
